english: Then I disagree with the third part of your reason: it is not the case that there are many examples of things which are not that which is neither a quality of unchanging things, nor characteristic of them, but which are still unchanging things. Suppose you do disagree. There do too exist many examples of things which are not that which is neither a quality of unchanging things, nor characteristic of them, but which are still unchanging things; Because there do exist many examples of things which are both a quality of unchanging things, and characteristic of them, and which are also an unchanging thing.
